football-schedule.html.gz.note: Official 2026 Utah Football schedule, unmodified. Its __NUXT_DATA__ carries W/L, scores and recaps for W 66-14 Idaho (Sep 3), W 43-10 Arkansas (Sep 12), W 33-0 Utah State (Sep 19) and W 31-17 at Iowa State (Sep 26). utahutes.com returned HTTP 403 to the sandbox on most attempts; this copy came through on a normal retry.

cross-country-schedule.html.gz.note: Official 2026 Utah Cross Country schedule, unmodified. Final meets: UVU Invitational (Sep 4, 3rd / 8), Beehive Invitational (Sep 10, No Score), John McNichols Invitational (Sep 19, 2nd / 28); each card links its official recap. No results documents are linked.

beach-volleyball-schedule.html.gz.note: Official Utah Beach Volleyball schedule, unmodified. The page still shows the 2025 spring season (35 matches, Feb 22 - Apr 25, 2025); no 2026-27 matches are published.

missing-sport-template.html.gz.note: What utahutes.com serves for a sport slug it does not have (Utah's skiing page is alpine-skiing): SIDEARM's unfilled "@season @sport Schedule" template with no schedule data. The old beach-volleyball route served the same template, whose site-wide ticker put indoor volleyball matches on Beach Volleyball.

lacrosse-schedule.html.gz.note: Official Utah (men's) Lacrosse schedule, unmodified: the 2026 spring season (15 games, Jan 23 - May 1, 2026; last two L 13-14 and L 12-13 vs Air Force). No 2027 games are published. The site links only mens-lacrosse.

skiing-schedule.html.gz.note: Official 2027 Utah Skiing schedule, unmodified: 31 races, Jan 2 - Mar 13, 2027. Each race's meet (Utah Invitational, RMISA Qualifiers, Denver Invitational, ...) is in the page data's tournament field. The old skiing route served the empty template (missing-sport-template.html.gz), so the feed returned 502.

golf-schedule.html.gz.note: Official 2026-27 Utah Men's Golf schedule, unmodified. Each round day is its own entry: Jackson Stephens Cup Sep 14-16 (all rounds final, each with a daily recap), Mark Simpson Collegiate Sep 29 (final) - Sep 30 (today), then 11 upcoming tournaments. No placings are published (prescore_info empty). The site links only mens-golf.

mens-tennis-schedule.html.gz.note: Official 2026-27 Utah Men's Tennis schedule, unmodified: 22 events from the Utah Invitational (Oct 2) through the spring. Tennis used to stop at the women's page, so none of these appeared.

xc-recap-uvu-invitational.html.gz.note: Official recap, unmodified. One results table under UVU INVITATIONAL: 76 Points, 3rd / 8, seven Utah runners.

xc-recap-john-mcnichols-invitational.htm.note: Official recap, unmodified. Two results tables: the championship race (2nd / 28, 107 Points, eight Utah runners) and the "OPEN RACE" (two Utah runners). Its prose also reports an alumna's result at another event, which has no table.
